label: Drum & Bass
direction: Fast broken kick/snare rhythm, rolling or syncopated deep bass, tight hats; dark or energetic electronic texture. No piano or orchestral material.

label: Jungle
direction: Chopped breakbeat feel using kick/snare/hat patterns, dubby bass, occasional vocal fragments. No piano or orchestra.

label: House
direction: Four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat hats, syncopated bass and warm chord stabs; piano P or Q can suit the groove.

label: Deep House
direction: Restrained four-on-the-floor groove, warm extended chords, rounded bass, space and soulful piano if appropriate.

label: Tech House
direction: Stripped four-on-the-floor drums, short rolling bass, sparse vocal or electronic stabs; avoid orchestral and piano layers.

label: Techno
direction: Driving four-on-the-floor percussion and repetitive bass or modular motion; no piano or orchestra.

label: Trance
direction: Driving kick and offbeat or rolling bass, melodic lead and evolving harmonic tension; choose compatible notes and restrained layers.

label: UK Garage
direction: Syncopated two-step kick/snare placement, skipping hats, sub bass and chopped vocals or short chord stabs.

label: Breakbeat
direction: Broken syncopated drums, strong snare backbeat, electronic bass and fragmented sample hooks; no orchestra.

label: Electro
direction: Machine-like broken drums, syncopated bass and short robotic leads; sparse electronic texture, no piano or orchestra.

label: Dub Techno
direction: Restrained steady pulse, deep bass and sparse repetitive electronic chord fragments. No orchestral or piano source.

label: Ambient Electronic
direction: Slow evolving electronic textures, long notes and substantial rests; drums optional and minimal. Avoid acoustic piano/orchestra.

label: IDM / Glitch
direction: Asymmetric kick/snare/hat steps and fractured electronic motifs; use W modular and L Terra together, subtle bass optional. No piano or orchestra.

label: Industrial
direction: Mechanical repetition, stark bass and sparse abrasive modular/Terra motifs; use W and L Terra. No piano or orchestra.

label: Experimental Electronic
direction: Choose an unusual coherent pulse and unpredictable rests, modular W and Terra L textures; use both. Optional loaded atmospheric audio only if available. No piano or orchestra.
